cardDesc: Text mining and sentiment analysis on 8,387 CoffeeReview comments: unigrams, bigrams, LDA at k = 3/5/7, TF–IDF vs rating, and Bing/AFINN/NRC sentiment — sweet, chocolate, and fruit as the vocabulary of quality.
title: What Makes a Good Coffee?
overview: Using text mining and sentiment analysis on 8,387 coffee review comments, we investigate what coffee features significantly boost the rating score of a professional reviewer — across Blind Assessment, Notes, Who Should Drink It, and Bottom Line text from CoffeeReview.com (1997–2025).
details: Top unigrams and bigrams per category (faceted bar charts): sweet, chocolate, and fruit rank among the most prominent terms across all four comment fields
LDA at k = 3, 5, and 7: sweet, chocolate, and fruit stay the highest-beta words across topic counts and categories
Average TF-IDF vs rating is negatively correlated in every category; net sentiment from three lexicons positively tracks rating, with clear drops in 2008–2009 and 2020–2021
